edges.reason: Constructor assigns ceoAddress directly from msg.sender, making ownership deployer controlled.
onlyTokenContract modifier requires msg.sender == address(tokenContract) before tokenFallback runs.
hatcheryShrimp is read and written using msg.sender as the mapping key.
claimedEggs is read and written using msg.sender as the mapping key.
lastHatch is written using msg.sender as the mapping key.
referrals lookup and assignment are keyed by msg.sender.
seedMarket requires msg.sender == ceoAddress to initialise the market.
block.timestamp (now) is written into lastHatch, creating timestamp dependency.
getEggsSinceLastHatch subtracts now from lastHatch, making accrual timestamp dependent.
secondsPassed is derived from now, so the reward rate depends on miner-controllable time.
claimedEggs[_from] is credited with eggsBought for the token sender.
_value is priced through calculateEggBuy and stored into eggsBought.
devFee(_value) is transferred out of the contract to the CEO address.
Net eggsBought is added to claimedEggs[_from].
Cached token balance ElyxrBalance is passed to calculateEggBuy to derive eggsBought.
tokenContract.myTokens() result is stored into ElyxrBalance.
tokenFallback queries the external token balance through myTokens().
seedMarket assigns the eggs parameter to marketEggs.
The ref parameter becomes the caller's referrer in the referrals mapping.
eggsUsed is divided by EGGS_TO_HATCH_1SHRIMP to produce newShrimp.
newShrimp is added to hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender].
Referral bonus is computed as SafeMath.div(eggsUsed, 5) and credited to claimedEggs[referrer].
marketEggs is inflated by SafeMath.div(eggsUsed, 10) to nerf hoarding.
devFee multiplies the amount parameter by 4 and divides by 100.
adr indexes lastHatch and hatcheryShrimp inside getEggsSinceLastHatch.
_user is passed into the extcodesize assembly block.
hasEggs is priced by calculateEggSell into eggValue.
fee is derived from eggValue through devFee.
The remaining eggValue minus fee is transferred to the seller.
The computed fee is transferred to ceoAddress.
tokenFallback invokes reinvest() before crediting eggs.
reinvest() forwards the call to the external tokenContract.reinvest().
tokenFallback calls calculateEggBuy to price the incoming tokens.
calculateEggBuy delegates the pricing math to calculateTrade.
calculateEggSell delegates the pricing math to calculateTrade.
calculateEggBuySimple wraps calculateEggBuy.
getMyEggs adds the result of getEggsSinceLastHatch for the caller.
getEggsSinceLastHatch clamps elapsed time using the min helper.
_isContract executes the extcodesize assembly to measure code size.
tokenFallback requires !_isContract(_from), rejecting contract senders.
sellEggs calls reinvest() before paying out.
sellEggs calls calculateEggSell to value the eggs.
sellEggs performs external token transfers for the fee and payout.
reinvest reads tokenContract.myDividends(true) before reinvesting.
getContractDividends queries tokenContract.myDividends(true).
getBalance reads the token balance via myTokens().
calculateEggSell reads the live token balance via myTokens().
calculateEggBuySimple reads the live token balance via myTokens().
tokenFallback reads myTokens() twice to derive the contract balance.
The external token transfer can re-enter tokenFallback in a malicious or hooked token contract.
Transfers in sellEggs occur after reinvest() and can be re-entered to repeat the payout path.
The external reinvest() call is made before eggs are credited, allowing cross-function re-entry.
Parameter a is compared inside the min helper.
Parameter b is compared inside the min helper.
_data metadata is accepted by tokenFallback and kept for ERC677 compatibility.
The extcodesize result is stored into the size local variable.
hatchEggs uses msg.sender for referral resolution and shrimp/egg bookkeeping.
sellEggs credits and pays the caller identified by msg.sender.
getMyShrimp returns hatcheryShrimp indexed by msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to key claimedEggs and validate the caller inside tokenFallback.
The token amount parameter is consumed entirely by the tokenFallback pricing and fee logic.
The metadata blob is an unused ERC677 compatibility argument of tokenFallback.
The referrer parameter is only used to populate the referrals mapping in hatchEggs.
The egg amount parameter only initialises marketEggs in the CEO seeding function.
The amount parameter exists solely to compute the 4% developer fee.
The address parameter is only used to index lastHatch and hatcheryShrimp in the accrual helper.
The address parameter is only consumed by the extcodesize check in _isContract.
First operand of the pure min helper, folded into the helper function.
Second operand of the pure min helper, folded into the helper function.
Temporary pricing result inside tokenFallback that is immediately credited to claimedEggs.
Cached token balance local scoped to the tokenFallback buy calculation.
Locally cached accrued eggs consumed by the hatchEggs conversion and referral payout.
Intermediate shrimp amount minted and stored inside hatchEggs.
Locally cached egg balance sold inside sellEggs.
Intermediate token value of the sold eggs inside sellEggs.
Dev fee deducted from the sale proceeds inside sellEggs.
Timestamp-derived intermediate that exists only inside the accrual helper.
Assembly output local whose sole purpose is the boolean returned by _isContract.
